Core Computer Science curriculum focusing on the mathematical and theoretical foundations of computing.

  • Computer Science Fundamentals: Deep dive into algorithmic complexity (Big O), memory management, concurrency, and thread safety in Java/C++.
  • System Design: Studied the architecture of scalable operating systems and distributed networks.
  • Capstone Project: Developed "EcotrashV2", a full-stack mobile solution for waste management, applying concepts of Geolocation APIs and Cloud Database integration.

A rigorous STEM foundation degree focused on interdisciplinary problem-solving. This program provided a deep mathematical and scientific background essential for complex software engineering.

  • Core Curriculum: Mastered heavy quantitative subjects including Multivariable Calculus, Differential Equations, and Probability Statistics.
  • Scientific Approach: Developed strong analytical skills to approach technological problems using the scientific method and data analysis.
  • Served as the foundational track before specializing in Software Engineering.

frontmatter.title: Technical High School in Software Development

node.html:
Comprehensive program focused on full software development lifecycle. Built a strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and relational database modeling.

  • Capstone Project: Developed a desktop management system for local businesses using Java and MySQL.
  • Learned hardware fundamentals, networking basics, and agile logic early in the career.
  • Graduated with honors in logic and programming logic.
